features.title: From image to publish-ready alt text
features.subtitle: A focused workflow for accurate descriptions, natural keyword use, and faster publishing.
features.contextBody: Give the generator a product or content title, brand, focus keyword, and any nearby page context.
features.subscriptionsBody: AI describes what is visible, uses your keyword only when it fits, and returns concise alt text you can edit.
features.metadataBody: Copy the final text into your CMS or download uploaded images with the description embedded as metadata.

platforms.title: Work on the page, not around it
platforms.subtitle: Use the web app for uploads or the Chrome extension to collect images and generate alt text from the page you are editing.
